decisions.decision: Continue the approved roadmap autonomously, one implementation PR at a time, toward working, integrated, tested and progressively certified software (code, tests, API/MCP, web UI, paper trading, replay, backtest), not documentation-only PRs where implementation work exists. Authoritative sources: #3, #97, #104, #12, #20, #40, #24, #28, #34, #94, #96, #99, #98, #102, #45 plus AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and later owner decisions; the most recent owner instruction prevails on the same scope; the residual of #104 is reconstructed from issues, code, tests and merges, not taken as 82 open PRs. Before any new PR: complete PR #162 under its gates (CI, independent review valid on the current head, NB-5..NB-9 reconciled, R-06a checkpoint timestamp error corrected and traceable without invented times, merge gate), verify the merge on GitHub, main SHA, CI and the absence of unauthorized deploys; then R-06b and the current order. Certification levels: IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, COMPONENT CERTIFIED, INTEGRATION CERTIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, BLOCKED; mocks or synthetic tests alone never certify real behaviour. Certify progressively Trading Engine #28 -> Money Management #96 -> Positions/Ledger #99 with Market Rules #100, Strategy Lab #34, Replay #24 and Operator API/MCP #98; requirements needing new live data are NOT VERIFIED without blocking other modules. No Render deploy or reactivation of matchpilot-test, no unauthorized production Neon migration, no destructive archive change, no new paid service, no real trading, no automatic closing of owner issues; Auto-Deploy may be on while suspended, so the risk is checked before each merge and deploy events after it. Per PR report: issue and requirement, PR, branch, head and merge SHA, code, tests PASS/FAIL/SKIP, Gate A/B, review and findings, CI, deploy state, certified and unverified requirements, next PR. Stop only for new features or substantial behaviour changes, unapproved economic or risk changes, new paid providers or costs, unauthorized deploys, production migrations or destructive operations, real-money trading, genuine unresolvable owner-decision conflicts, or security/integrity problems that prevent reliable progress.

decisions.decision: MatchPilot is developed and tested on the real data already collected and stored. In this phase no new FutPythonTrader or TotalCorner calls are mandatory for features that can run on persisted data. Before declaring a dataset available verify for real: existence, accessibility and integrity of the archives; hashes, manifest and provenance; unique matches, not only raw records; availability of prematch, live, odds, events and results; provider and acquisition timestamps; coverage by league, season and market; gaps, missing data and parser versions. The #40 trial archive is not assumed equal to the full FPT and TotalCorner archives. Provider adapters stay compatible with a future authorized reactivation. Missing odds, events or snapshots are never invented. Replay and backtest respect the real time availability of the data with no future leakage.
